correctness.rationale: For every prime-power q and n>=1, reconstruct the unique CRT polynomial idempotent E=3A^2-2A^3 from A^2(A-I)^2=0; E^2=E, N=A-E is square-zero, EN=NE, including characteristic 2 and 3. Every triangular idempotent with fixed binary diagonal of a ones lies in a single unitriangular conjugacy orbit of size q^{a(n-a)}: g=ED+(I-E)(I-D) is unitriangular and Eg=gD. Commutation splits N into two independent strictly upper-triangular square-zero parts. Last-column extension proves f_{m,r}=q^r f_{m-1,r}+(q^{m-r}-q^{r-1})f_{m-1,r-1}, with zero boundaries, hence the complete paired Jordan multiplicity binom(n,a) q^{a(n-a)} f_{a,i}f_{n-a,j}. Independently enumerated all 64,1024,32768 triangular binary matrices for n=3,4,5: 60,824,20224 solutions with all 8,14,20 refined strata exactly matching formula; finite checks corroborate but do not establish universality.
